intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna unfolds a rota from her apron. Every hour is filled in, in very small handwriting.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Under *Pim: sweets, bandages, no needles* is your name. Beside it: *Moral support.*

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Correct. That’s why you’re not on bandages.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “It’s a real post. Dorrance has one too. His says *Leeches (supervised).*”

options.labelText: “I accept. First job offer I’ve ever had. What are the duties?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Sit within reach. Hand me things when I point. Sit within reach some more.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “One boiled sweet per shift. Don’t tell Pim. He’s on half.”

options.labelText: “Couldn’t we do something fun instead? You’re always working.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She folds the rota back into her apron. Your name ends up on the inside of the fold.
